faqs.question: What is an AI WhatsApp Chatbot?
faqs.answer: An AI WhatsApp Chatbot is an intelligent virtual assistant that automates customer conversations on WhatsApp using Artificial Intelligence and the Official WhatsApp Business API. It can answer customer queries, recommend products, qualify leads, automate support, recover abandoned carts, book appointments, and seamlessly transfer conversations to live agents, helping businesses deliver faster and more personalized customer experiences.

faqs.question: How does a WhatsApp Chatbot work?
faqs.answer: A WhatsApp Chatbot interacts with customers through the Official WhatsApp Business API. It understands customer intent, retrieves information from your website or knowledge base, executes automated workflows, and provides instant responses. An AI WhatsApp Chatbot can also answer complex questions, recommend products, and support customers throughout their journey.

faqs.question: What is the difference between an WhatsApp AI Chatbot and a Rule-Based Chatbot?
faqs.answer: A rule-based chatbot for WhatsApp follows predefined conversation flows and decision trees, while an AI WhatsApp Chatbot understands natural language, interprets customer intent, remembers conversation context, and delivers human-like responses. It can also learn from your business knowledge to provide more accurate and personalized interactions.

faqs.question: Can I build a WhatsApp Chatbot without coding?
faqs.answer: Yes. MSG91 provides a no-code WhatsApp Chatbot Builder that lets you create conversation flows, automate customer journeys, and deploy an AI WhatsApp Chatbot without writing a single line of code.

faqs.question: Does the chatbot work with the Official WhatsApp Business API?
faqs.answer: Yes. MSG91's WhatsApp Chatbot is built on the Official WhatsApp Business API, enabling secure, reliable, and scalable customer communication while ensuring compliance with Meta's policies.

faqs.question: Can the chatbot answer questions using my website or FAQs?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Train your AI WhatsApp Chatbot using your website, FAQs, product documentation, PDFs, and knowledge base. This enables the chatbot to deliver accurate, contextual responses to customer queries.

faqs.question: Can I train the chatbot using PDF documents?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upload PDFs such as user manuals, brochures, policy documents, product guides, or knowledge base documents. Your WhatsApp AI Chatbot can use this information to answer customer questions accurately.

faqs.question: Can the chatbot recommend products to customers?
faqs.answer: Yes. The AI WhatsApp Chatbot can recommend products based on customer preferences, browsing behavior, previous purchases, or predefined business rules. It can also share product catalogs, images, and interactive messages directly within WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Can I automate customer support using the chatbot?
faqs.answer: Yes. A WhatsApp Chatbot for Business can automate FAQs, order tracking, returns, refunds, complaint registration, appointment scheduling, and many other support workflows, helping businesses reduce response times and improve customer satisfaction.

faqs.question: Does the chatbot support WhatsApp Bulk Messaging campaigns?
faqs.answer: Yes. The WhatsApp Chatbot works alongside WhatsApp Bulk Messaging campaigns by automatically responding to customer replies, qualifying leads, answering questions, and continuing conversations after a campaign is delivered.

faqs.question: Which industries can use the MSG91 WhatsApp Chatbot?
faqs.answer: MSG91's WhatsApp Chatbot for Business is designed for Ecommerce, Healthcare, Education, BFSI, Real Estate, Travel & Hospitality, Retail, Manufacturing, Automotive, SaaS, and many other industries. The platform can be customized to fit your unique business workflows.

faqs.question: Can the chatbot integrate with Shopify or WooCommerce?
faqs.answer: Yes. The chatbot integrates with Shopify and WooCommerce to automate product recommendations, abandoned cart recovery, order tracking, payment reminders, and customer support directly on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Is customer data secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. MSG91 follows enterprise-grade security standards and operates on the Official WhatsApp Business API. Customer conversations are protected through secure infrastructure, encrypted communication, role-based access controls, and reliable messaging architecture.

faqs.question: Can the chatbot support multiple languages?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Chatbot for WhatsApp supports multiple languages, enabling businesses to deliver localized and personalized customer experiences across different regions.

faqs.question: Can I send images, videos, PDFs, and catalogs through the chatbot?
faqs.answer: Yes. The AI WhatsApp Chatbot supports rich media including images, videos, PDFs, documents, product catalogs, interactive buttons, carousel messages, and location sharing to create engaging customer conversations.

faqs.question: Why should I choose MSG91's AI WhatsApp Chatbot?
faqs.answer: MSG91 combines an AI WhatsApp Chatbot, the Official WhatsApp Business API, a no-code WhatsApp Chatbot Builder, live agent handover, enterprise-grade security, deep integrations, and advanced analytics into one platform. Whether your goal is to automate customer support, improve sales, or enhance customer engagement, MSG91 provides everything you need to build intelligent WhatsApp experiences at scale.
